description.value: Private campground set right on the Harrison River at Harrison Mills, with 30 tent sites, hot showers, flush washrooms, a swimming dock, and a playground; summer-seasonal, at the end of Kennedy Road near Harrison Mills.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and detailed, providing the authoritative address (1201 Kennedy Road, Harrison Mills, BC) absent from OSM. A phone number conflict exists: OSM has +1-604-799-0319 while the website consistently shows 604-799-0329 across multiple pages — the website value is preferred. The /book-online page explicitly lists amenities including hot showers, laundry, water, ice for sale, and a reservations system, enabling confident true/null assignments; no cycling-specific infrastructure (hiker/biker sites, pump, tools) is mentioned.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM has +1-604-799-0319 but the website consistently shows 604-799-0329 on all pages including contact and booking — OSM value appears to have a digit error.
OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but the campground address is Harrison Mills, BC — a different municipality.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-documented campground with tent/dry sites, showers, laundry, and water — solid amenity set for a touring cyclist stopping along the Harrison River corridor.

wow_evidence: 30 tent sites, hot showers, flush washrooms, a swimming dock
